citations.field: 比部; PDF p. 738, printed p. 725; 董莲池’s formation and meaning account
citations.text: 董莲池 proposes an ideographic construction from two 匕, described as ancient shallow, long-handled food ladles with pointed ends. The entry says juxtaposing them expresses nearness or adjacency and explicitly says 匕 also cues the pronunciation. It treats “密也” from Shuowen as semantically compatible but rejects Shuowen’s two-person/reversed-从 analysis. It proposes extension from adjacency/nearness to union, factional association and comparison, and cites a Shang oracle-bone phrase 王比望乘伐下危 as using 比 for union. These are the author’s analyses, not independently settled conclusions. The exact printed component named in the sound clause is 匕.
